notes: Input conditioning defect observed on hardware. A single illumination over-counted triggers, which would collapse the five-interval mean and repeatedly restart the slice schedule. Fix implemented but NOT yet board-tested: fixed 1 ms debounce window plus 1 ms hold-off window, verified only in XSim (tb_ir_debounce PASS). Interval timestamps are taken at the accepted edge so the window does not bias the period. Re-test = one manual occlusion must give exactly one D7 blink and one D8 count.
